subject: general
question: 'Operation Thirst' was launched by the:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Railway Protection Force**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Railway Protection Force (RPF) is a security force, established by the Railway Protection Force Act, 1957, enacted by the Indian Parliament.
 
• RPF is responsible for the protection of railway property, passengers, and passenger areas.
 
• Operation Thirst was launched by RPF to check the menace of unauthorized packaged drinking water being sold at railway stations and trains.
 
• RPF has the power to search, arrest, investigate, and prosecute offenders for unlawful possession of railway property.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Border Security Force (BSF)**

 
 
• BSF is one of the five Central Armed Police Forces of India.
 
• It is responsible for guarding India's land border during peacetime and preventing transnational crime.
 
• BSF was established on December 1, 1965, in response to the 1965 India-Pakistan war.
 
 
 
• **Delhi Police**
 
 
• The Delhi Police is the law enforcement agency for the National Capital Territory of Delhi (NCT).
 
• It was established in 1861 under the British rule.
 
• Delhi Police is responsible for maintaining law and order, prevention and detection of crime, and traffic management in Delhi.
 
 
 
• **Central Industrial Security Force (CISF)**
 
 
• CISF is a Central Armed Police Force in India.
 
• It was established on March 10, 1969.
 
• CISF provides security cover to industrial units, government infrastructure projects, and facilities, and also provides consultancy services to private industries and other organizations.
